title: OpenCode LSP workstation setup harness
purpose: Give low-capability agents and Windows operators one deterministic path to recover a canonical checkout, inspect, configure, verify, and hand off OpenCode LSP enablement without changing product code, governance, secrets, or existing OpenCode configuration.

repositoryRecovery.proofRule: Only an exact canonical GitHub origin plus expected branch/head may become the setup worktree; a non-Git folder is preserved and never upgraded in place.

upstreamContract.stableLspRule: LSP is disabled by default; lsp=true enables built-in servers whose file types and prerequisites are present.
upstreamContract.configPrecedenceRule: OPENCODE_CONFIG_CONTENT is the highest runtime config source; the generated launcher preserves inherited inline values in memory and forces lsp=true there.
upstreamContract.interactiveModelRule: The current OpenCode TUI accepts --model/-m on the top-level opencode command.
upstreamContract.v2Boundary: Current OpenCode V2 documentation accepts LSP configuration but does not provide an LSP runtime; fail closed on a detected v2 command/version.

safety.proofCeiling: Static/hosted validation proves harness structure and setup logic. Checkout recovery can prove canonical repository acquisition and exact-head isolated worktree state. Workstation execution can prove OpenCode command/version resolution, immutable machine-local config artifacts, model visibility, and launcher generation. Active LSP diagnostics require opening a supported file and observing runtime behavior.
